changelog: Fix: backfill.php crashed on its very first write with PDOException 1052 "Column 'earliest_open_time' in field list is ambiguous." Cause: helpers's row-alias INSERT ... AS new ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE (added in v3.19.0 to avoid the deprecated VALUES() function) had bare, unqualified column references inside candle_sync's earliest/latest-tracking CASE expressions. MySQL 8.4 requires every column reference to be qualified once a row alias is present -- new.col for the row being inserted, candle_sync.col for the existing stored row -- an unqualified bare name is genuinely ambiguous, not merely deprecated, once the alias exists. Fixed in includes/bybit_client.php::backtestUpdateSyncState().

Checked the candles table's own upsert (backtestUpsertCandles()) for the same pattern, since it had not executed yet on live. Confirmed safe: every column reference in its ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE clause was already qualified (new.col), with no bare reference anywhere -- no change was needed there, and this was verified by inspection against the same MySQL 8.4 row-alias rules that caught the candle_sync bug, not assumed.

Moved docs/backtesting-pipeline.md to app/docs/backtesting-pipeline.md. It was committed at the repo root in v3.19.0 and never actually deployed: updater.php's GITHUB_BASE_URL fetch root is '.../main/app', so a files entry naming the repo-root path would 404 and fail the whole Update Now. Living under app/ now makes it a normal deployable file, matching this release's own files entry for it.
